title: Fees, Cost Transparency & Refund Policy
text:
Q: What is O.G. Agency's policy regarding recruitment fees and payments?
A: O.G. Agency (SLBFE License No. 2751) operates under strict ethical recruitment standards and government regulations:
1. Zero Exploitative Charges: We do not charge unauthorized placement fees. For many corporate partner roles, employers provide free visa processing and airfare sponsorship.
2. Transparent Invoicing: All official administrative costs, credential verification fees, and immigration processing charges are clearly detailed before work begins.
3. Official Payment Channels Only: Payments must be made exclusively via bank transfer to O.G. Agency's authorized company bank account or paid directly at our official cashier counter (No. 586/3, Walgama, Nagahawatta Malwana) with an official stamped receipt. We never accept informal cash payments or third-party agent money transfers.

title: Fees, Cost Transparency & Refund Policy
text:
Q: What is the refund policy if a visa or service is delayed or rejected?
A: Under O.G. Agency's Terms of Service:
- Consulting, skills assessment, and credential verification fees are non-refundable once document processing has commenced.
- In the rare event that a candidate's visa application is rejected solely due to a document filing error on O.G. Agency's part, a full review will be conducted, and a partial refund or complimentary re-filing policy will apply.
- Third-party fees paid directly to external entities (such as medical clinics for GAMCA tests, embassy visa fee receipts, and police clearance departments) are subject to those external entities' respective non-refundable rules.

title: Recruitment Process & Workflow Timeline
text:
Q: How does the international recruitment process work at O.G. Agency?
A: O.G. Agency follows a proven, transparent 5-step hiring journey:
- Step 01 (Tell Us What You Need): Candidates register online or in-office with their CV, skills, and aspirations. Corporate employers submit job roles, required skills, and timelines.
- Step 02 (Smart Candidate Matching): Our team searches our global talent database and shortlists candidates with the right skills, experience, and language proficiency.
- Step 03 (Credential Verification & Trade Testing): We verify educational diplomas, certificates, and work references with issuing institutions and previous employers. Candidates undergo practical trade tests where required.
- Step 04 (Paperwork, Medicals & Visa Processing): We manage full visa applications, embassy appointments, GAMCA/Wafid medical fitness checks, and legal compliance.
- Step 05 (Relocation, Arrival & Onboarding): We coordinate flight bookings, travel logistics, cultural orientation training, and airport reception so new hires settle in smoothly.

title: Recruitment Process & Workflow Timeline
text:
Q: How long does the recruitment and deployment process take?
A: The typical timeline from candidate shortlisting to foreign deployment ranges between 35 and 75 days, depending on the role, destination country immigration rules, and embassy appointment availability. Using our expedited visa and pre-verified credential pipeline can shorten this timeline by up to 25 days. Processing starts within 24 hours of onboarding.

title: Visa Requirements, Medical Fitness & Document Verification
text:
Q: What mandatory documents are required to apply for a visa and job placement through O.G. Agency?
A: Candidates must provide the following 8 mandatory documents for overseas job applications:
1. Valid International Passport: Minimum 1-2 years remaining validity with at least 4 blank visa pages.
2. Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV / Resume): Detailing education, technical qualifications, and comprehensive work experience.
3. Educational & Vocational Certificates: Original academic degrees, diplomas, and technical trade certification records.
4. Experience & Reference Letters: Service letters from previous employers verifying dates and job responsibilities.
5. Passport-Size Photographs: Clear photographs with white background matching destination country embassy specifications.
6. Police Clearance Certificate (PCC): Official certificate issued by the relevant government police department confirming no criminal record.
7. Medical Examination Fitness Certificate: GAMCA / Wafid medical fitness test approval for Gulf countries, or screening from accredited medical centers for Europe.
8. National Identity Document: Copy of National Identity Card (NIC / Aadhaar / National ID).

title: Visa Requirements, Medical Fitness & Document Verification
text:
Q: What is the medical examination procedure for Gulf (GCC) and European work visas?
A: Medical clearance is mandatory before visa issuance:
- GCC Countries (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain): Candidates must undergo medical tests through GAMCA (Gulf Approved Medical Centers Association) / Wafid authorized clinics.
- European & Other Destinations: Medical examinations are conducted at designated embassy-accredited hospitals.
- Standard medical tests include chest X-ray, blood screenings, vision check, and general physical fitness evaluation.

title: Visa Requirements, Medical Fitness & Document Verification
text:
Q: How are document attestation, Apostille, and credential verification handled?
A: O.G. Agency coordinates complete document legalization and verification:
- Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) attestation for educational and civil certificates.
- Apostille and Embassy document attestation for European and overseas jurisdictions.
- Direct verification with issuing universities and past employers to guarantee 100% genuine credentials and protect candidate eligibility.
